selection.rule: PREREG §1: objective = BLiPS-val v2 D-mode cluster-balanced AUC; SE = homology-group vertex bootstrap (B as run); one-SE rule, simplest = non-learned < learned, then fewer stored dims, then no CSLS, then grid order; guards BLiPS-val L cb-AUC >= B1 (default, raw) and TOUGH-M1-dev D cb-AUC >= B1 (default, raw); if the simplest within one SE fails a guard, the next simplest within one SE, then the remaining candidates by decreasing objective
